cases.name: Brooke Nia Zimmerman Raia
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "She was a 2008 graduate of Williamsburg High School.  Brooke was employed as an office manager at Traficante Family Chiropractic in Altoona and was also working at the Amazon warehouse located in Altoona.

     Brooke loved spending time with family, especially with her boys, Kamden and Easton and also playing in alumni basketball games with her former Blue Pirate teammates, known as “The Bad Moms Club”.   She also enjoyed vacationing with her family, some of her favorite places were the beach, the Caribbean and going to Atlanta to watch the Braves."
cases.narrative: Logan Township Police Chief Dave Hoover told the Altoona Mirror officers believe Blase her in the head with a handgun following a 'domestic dispute' in the basement of their home.
